A trigger on Opportunity updates the parent Account. Fire it after insert, update, delete and undelete, because all four change the total.
Collect AccountIds from Trigger.new, plus Trigger.old on update and delete. An opportunity can move to a different account, so both old and new accounts need recalculating.
Recalculate with one aggregate query: SELECT AccountId, SUM(Amount) FROM Opportunity WHERE AccountId IN :ids AND StageName = 'Closed Won' GROUP BY AccountId. Accounts with no rows get 0.
